name: NCT Alliance Berhad
overview: 2026年，NCT Alliance Berhad 通过子公司 NCT World Sdn. Bhd. 拟以 RM53.0 million 认购 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 80% 扩大后股权，并通过 NCT Panorama Sdn. Bhd. 拟以 RM22.0 million 收购 NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd.（前称 Setara Juara Sdn. Bhd.）51% 股权，两项交易均处于条件落实阶段。此外，NCT Land Sdn. Bhd. 与 Guangzhou Great Power Energy & Technology Co.
overview_en: In 2026, NCT Alliance Berhad, through its wholly-owned subsidiary NCT World Sdn. Bhd., proposed to subscribe for 80% of the enlarged equity interest in Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. for RM53.0 million, and through NCT Panorama Sdn. Bhd. proposed to acquire 51% equity interest in NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. (formerly Setara Juara Sdn. Bhd.) for RM22.0 million; both transactions remain subject to fulfilment of conditions. Separately, the memorandum/agreement between NCT Land Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 房地产开发
segments.note: 年内推进两项股权收购/认购，以扩大房地产开发业务的项目组合。
segments.note_en: During the year, the group progressed two equity acquisition/subscription transactions to expand its property development project portfolio.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT World Sdn. Bhd. 与 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 及相关方签署补充协议，修订上述股份认购及股东协议的若干条款。
actions.text_en: NCT World Sdn. Bhd. entered into a supplemental agreement with Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. and relevant parties to vary certain terms of the shares subscription and shareholders' agreement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述收购 NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权的条件落实期限进一步延长三个月，由 2026 年 9 月 19 日延长至 2026 年 12 月 19 日。
actions.text_en: The conditional period for the proposed acquisition of 51% equity interest in NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd. was further extended by three months from 19 September 2026 to 19 December 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述拟认购 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 80% 扩大后股权（代价 RM53.0 million）的公告作出修订。
actions.text_en: Amended announcement in relation to the proposed subscription of 80% of the enlarged equity interest in Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. for a consideration of RM53.0 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT Panorama Sdn. Bhd. 拟以 RM22.0 million 收购 Setara Juara Sdn. Bhd.（现称 NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd.）51% 股权，条件落实期限获延长。
actions.text_en: NCT Panorama Sdn. Bhd.'s proposed acquisition of 51% equity interest in Setara Juara Sdn. Bhd. (now known as NCT Marina Bay Sdn. Bhd.) for RM22.0 million, with the conditional period extended.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT World Sdn. Bhd. 与 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 及其现有股东签署有条件股份认购及股东协议，拟以 RM53.0 million 认购 8 股新普通股，占扩大后股权的 80%。
actions.text_en: NCT World Sdn. Bhd. entered into a conditional shares subscription and shareholders' agreement with Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NCT World Sdn. Bhd. 与 Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. 签署条款清单，拟以 RM53.0 million 认购后者 998 股新普通股。
actions.text_en: NCT World Sdn. Bhd. entered into a term sheet with Semanja Murni Sdn. Bhd. to subscribe for 998 new ordinary shares in the latter for RM53.0 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 年内完成一项关联方收购及和解，并与 Guangzhou Great Power Energy & Technology Co. Ltd. 签署备忘录/协议，但暂无重大进展。
segments.note_en: During the year, the group completed a related party acquisition and settlement, and entered into a memorandum/agreement with Guangzhou Great Power Energy & Technology Co.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司就上述备忘录协议公告，自上次公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The company announced that there has been no material development on the above memorandum of agreement since the previous announcement.

actions.text_en: The company announced that there has been no material development on the above memorandum of agreement since the previous announcement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司就上述备忘录协议公告，自上次公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The company announced that there has been no material development on the above memorandum of agreement since the previous announcement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: NCT Land Sdn. Bhd. 与 Guangzhou Great Power Energy & Technology Co. Ltd. 于 2026 年 1 月 28 日签署备忘录协议。
actions.text_en: NCT Land Sdn. Bhd. entered into a memorandum of agreement with Guangzhou Great Power Energy & Technology Co. Ltd. dated 28 January 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司宣布关联方拟议收购、拟议和解及拟议修订已于 2026 年 1 月 6 日根据买卖协议条款完成。
actions.text_en: The company announced that the proposed related party acquisition, proposed settlement and proposed amendments were completed on 6 January 2026 in accordance with the terms of the sale and purchase agreement.
